title: Steel Water Requirement Bridge for M/S Yascon | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind built a 150 ft steel water requirement bridge for M/S Yascon at Petaro Cantt, Sindh: 6 ft wide, 30 ft high, 900 sq ft.
h1: Steel Water Requirement Bridge for M/S Yascon at Petaro Cantt, Sindh: 150 Feet Long
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. fabricated and erected a steel water requirement bridge for M/S Yascon at Petaro Cantt, Sindh. The bridge is 150 feet long, 6 feet wide and 30 feet high, with an area of 900 square feet.
alt: Steel bridge built by Steel Mind for M/S Yascon at Petaro Cantt, Sindh.

faq.q: How long is the Yascon bridge?
faq.a: It is 150 feet long, 6 feet wide and 30 feet high.

faq.q: Does Steel Mind work outside Punjab?
faq.a: Yes. It has completed projects in Sindh and in more than ten cities.

blocks.text: This project took Steel Mind outside Punjab, to Sindh. The bridge is a long, narrow steel structure. Parts were fabricated in the Lahore factory, delivered to the site and lifted into place by Steel Mind crews.

The span, the width and the height set the girder depth and the supports. A bridge stays outdoors, so the coating system matters a great deal. The crane size and the lift plan must fit the site. Steel parts are made in a factory, which cuts the amount of work done on site.
Steel Mind can fabricate and erect long steel structures away from its home city, and it works with infrastructure-type clients.
